# Signatories

## Project team

Shaurita D. Hutchins leads the project. I am a PhD candidate in genetics, genomics and bioinformatics at the University of Alabama at Birmingham, in the Worthey lab at the Center for Computational Genomics and Data Science, which interprets variants for rare and undiagnosed disease. I organise the Birmingham (Alabama) R Users Group. On this project I own the requirements and the design of the variant table, test every release on real case reviews, write the rare disease vignette, and run dissemination. ## Contributors

Samuel Bharti, doctoral researcher at the University of Alabama at Birmingham, contributes package development. He maintains the three packages tidyvar builds on: bioclients (<https://github.com/samuelbharti/bioclients>, r-universe), clients for gnomAD, ClinVar, Ensembl, UniProt and 25 other services with one row per input and envelope results instead of errors; biohttp (CRAN), the HTTP layer under it with cache, circuit breaker, rate limiting and batching; and biobouncer (CRAN and PyPI), validation of gene symbols, ontology terms and variant notation. His variant-reviewer Shiny app (<https://github.com/samuelbharti/variant-reviewer>), which reviews one variant across ClinVar, gnomAD, Ensembl and Open Targets, is where the joining and bookkeeping problem became concrete.
